program: Wingless external ambiguity-gated compositional prediction validity recovery
question: Was the invalid 512-pair composition result caused by unnecessary pruning at the terminal transition rather than by insufficient intermediate beam retention?
hypothesis: Reuse the exact sealed learned relations, ambiguity gate, 512 intermediate runtime beam, horizons, sources, and scientific thresholds from the invalid predecessor. The only algorithmic change is that the final transition at each horizon is never pruned in pair space: all terminal pair mass is aggregated directly into the 512 target-motif probabilities before argmax. The preregistered intermediate-beam validity floor remains 0.75. If validity passes, ambiguity-gated composition will improve pooled top-1 accuracy over first-order distributional composition by at least 0.002 at both horizons with no source worse by more than 0.01.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.exact_pair_relation: byte-identical predecessor top-511 exact-pair successor counts
frozen_reuse.intermediate_beam_tie_break: mass descending, previous motif ascending, current motif ascending

single_change.old_behavior: prune to 512 pair states after every transition including the terminal transition
single_change.new_behavior: after nonterminal transitions only, prune to 512 pair states; on the terminal transition aggregate all generated pair mass directly by target current motif with no pair-state pruning

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes and both horizon pooled-gain and source-nondegradation thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and at least one horizon improves over first-order distributional composition, but the full supported thresholds do not pass.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but neither horizon improves over first-order distributional composition.
classification_rules.invalid: Any sealed-parent, authority, source, split, gate, probability, intermediate-beam, terminal-aggregation, capacity, determinism, or heldout-isolation criterion fails.

validity_criteria: The previous 0.75 intermediate mass floor is retained exactly; it is not relaxed after observing the invalid predecessor.
No learned relation, gate, support threshold, ambiguity cutoff, source, split, horizon, or scientific gain threshold changes.
Only terminal pair pruning is removed because target prediction requires motif marginalization, not a terminal pair beam.
Intermediate pair-state pruning remains capped at exactly 512 and deterministic.
Terminal target probabilities sum all generated pair mass before argmax.
Duplicate complete probes are byte-identical and all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter the 0.75 mass floor, 512 intermediate beam cap, sources, split, representation, gate, transition probabilities, horizons, scientific thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: feed supported gated multi-step predictive state into bounded controlled reasoning

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: attribute residual depth error to transition quality rather than beam truncation

successor_if_invalid.intent: diagnose intermediate retained-mass capacity explicitly without lowering validity thresholds
